MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'})
WITH DISTINCT t
WITH count(t) AS totalTdocs,
     sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agreementLinkedTdocCount
RETURN agreementLinkedTdocCount,
       {numerator: agreementLinkedTdocCount, denominator: totalTdocs} AS agreementLinkedTdocShare

MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN1#120'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)
WHERE t.status = 'postponed'
RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber ASC
original_question: List the TDocs postponed to the next meeting at RAN1#120 (tracking open items).
